cnc_machines.notes: Sub-spindle tool setter = removable/swing tool-eye arm; tools touch off on a disc/contact post. Sub-spindle tool-eye SENSOR-POSITION parameters (per machine book): X surfaces = 2097X & 2098X; Z surfaces = 2097Z & 2098Z. Calibrate by measure-error->adjust-parameter loop with a mic-verified reference tool (X error is diametral: convert to mm, divide by 2 = radial correction). Re-run after any disc-post replacement or setter crash. Record old param values before changing so you can revert.
